Locked chats are hidden inside this app and protected by the secret code you set — not by your fingerprint or the phone\'s lock. Please understand:
(1) If you forget your secret code, there is NO way to recover these chats — no reset, no backdoor. That\'s what makes it secure.

(2) The words in a locked chat are encrypted on this device, and the copy in your phone\'s shared message storage is deleted — so another SMS app cannot read them. Two things stay readable: who you messaged and when. And once a chat is locked, its messages live only in this app — they will not show up in any other SMS app, and they reach a new phone only through this app\'s backup.
(3) Backups include locked chats in encrypted form; restoring them on any device requires this same secret code.
(4) Notifications for locked chats will only say \'New message\' — or can be turned off entirely inside the locked folder\'s settings.

Privacy Policy Last updated: 2026-08-07
Messages is a personal, on-device SMS application. It does not collect, transmit, store remotely, or share any personal data whatsoever.
All messages, contacts, and filter decisions remain exclusively on your device. No analytics, no crash reporting, no telemetry, and no network requests are made by this app.
The app requires SMS permissions solely to function as your default SMS handler. It requires Contacts permission solely to display sender names. No data derived from these permissions ever leaves your device.
This app has no backend, no accounts, and no third-party SDKs that transmit data.
If you have questions, open an issue at https://github.com/soul991/Messages
